direction: Performative closed-loop charging-demand forecasting under pricing, routing or control
core_scientific_question: How can a forecasting-control system learn when its own deployed action changes the future demand distribution, and converge safely under an uncertain response map?
nearest_prior_art_pressure: High generic theory and EV game/field evidence; no room for a simple forecast-price iteration
method_space: causal response map + performative risk/equilibrium + feedback-model ambiguity + safe exploration + grid constraints
primary_data: field intervention data if obtainable; otherwise calibrated agent/queue simulator plus external causal effect targets
recommended_role: High-upside flagship only after intervention-identifiability gate
go_no_go_test: A policy perturbation must produce a measurable, reproducible distribution change; static retraining must fail in closed loop; a response-map method must improve stability/risk under misspecification.

direction: Support-aware structural OOD forecasting for new stations under network expansion
core_scientific_question: Can demand at an unseen station be predicted when adding the station also redistributes demand across the existing network, and can the model know when transfer is unsupported?
nearest_prior_art_pressure: Cold-start, CalderaCast, GP expansion and demand-supply coupling already exist
method_space: graph intervention representation + analog retrieval + static/mobility semantics + joint network redistribution + trajectory uncertainty + selective abstention/fallback
primary_data: CHARGED + UrbanEV; semi-synthetic network expansion interventions; external planning tool comparisons
go_no_go_test: Under leave-station/network-intervention protocols, support scores must predict failure and selective prediction must reduce worst-domain/tail risk without trivial rejection.

direction: Service-realizable public-charging load forecasting with queue loss and station substitution
core_scientific_question: How much latent demand becomes delivered power after charger availability, queues, failures, balking, abandonment and station substitution?
nearest_prior_art_pressure: Censored-demand and queue-load models exist, but multi-mechanism service realization is not mature
method_space: censored marked point process + queue state + station choice/substitution graph + interval identification + joint delivered/lost demand scenarios
primary_data: requires queue/availability/failure/choice labels; ACN/UrbanEV alone are insufficient; EVQUARIUM for semi-synthetic gate
go_no_go_test: At least one real dataset must contain credible service-capacity and lost-demand indicators, or a natural intervention that allows partial identification.

direction: Operation-conditioned probabilistic depot-power forecasting for heavy-duty trucks or buses
core_scientific_question: How should routes, schedules, weather, traffic, vehicle rotations and disruptions be converted into calibrated depot-power scenarios that remain useful for robust dispatch?
nearest_prior_art_pressure: WeTRaC covers scalable route-GNN demand; RouteZero covers deterministic route energy plus depot LP
method_space: route-event graph + probabilistic trip energy/return-time/rotation + coherent depot aggregation + disruption OOD + learning-augmented robust scheduling
recommended_role: Strong practical alternative and fastest closed-loop validation
go_no_go_test: Probabilistic operational model must beat deterministic reconstruction on route/depot holdouts and materially reduce reserve/peak/unserved-service regret under disruptions.

direction: Inverse learning of latent charging flexibility and user preference from aggregate controlled power
core_scientific_question: Can feasible-set and price-response parameters be identified from aggregate power when individual sessions and objectives are hidden?
nearest_prior_art_pressure: Inverse optimization and behavioral inverse modelling already established
method_space: set-valued/partial identification + inverse optimization under censoring + policy-shift robustness + uncertainty sets
primary_data: controlled aggregate power with price/action variation; synthetic truth for identifiability; ideally real market bids
go_no_go_test: Show identifiable or bounded recovery under realistic observability; distinguish multiple latent models that produce the same aggregate load.

core_scientific_question: Can the model identify and safely cover rare fast-charging or synchronized-behavior peaks that dominate grid consequences?
nearest_prior_art_pressure: Behavioral grid-risk evidence is strong; ordinary probabilistic/conformal forecasting is crowded
method_space: extreme-value-aware scenario model + event definitions + peak trajectory regions + selective warning + grid consequence loss
primary_data: UrbanEV/CHARGED plus event labels or semi-synthetic stress tests; behavioral datasets
go_no_go_test: Tail metrics and grid violations must reveal failures hidden by MAE/CRPS, and warning/rejection must reduce consequence at acceptable false-alarm rates.

direction: Decision-focused multi-scenario generation for stochastic charging scheduling
core_scientific_question: Which aspects of the joint future scenario distribution must be learned to minimize dispatch regret rather than pointwise error?
nearest_prior_art_pressure: Diffusion scenarios, differentiable optimization and EV decision-focused RL are established
method_space: multivariate scenario compression + task-aware proper scoring + solver-free/implicit decision gradients + reliability guardrails
primary_data: ACN-Sim/EV2Gym or depot data with downstream stochastic program
recommended_role: Second-stage method after a forecasting problem is selected
go_no_go_test: Must improve out-of-sample dispatch regret and constraint risk over both statistically best forecasts and robust non-learning baselines.

direction: Trustworthy federated learning under structural and performative shift
core_scientific_question: How can private clients share knowledge when local actions, network changes and distribution shifts alter each client differently?
nearest_prior_art_pressure: Heterogeneous FL, federated conformal and attack defenses are already crowded
method_space: explicit threat model + decision-dependent client distributions + calibrated knowledge objects + reliability/attack gating
primary_data: CHARGED federated simulation plus controlled feedback environments
recommended_role: Project integration after central mechanism succeeds
go_no_go_test: Central structural/performative method must first work; then show privacy/threat and calibration benefits under a fixed client protocol.
